reference_sql:
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category_id IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS missing_share
FROM products
GROUP BY brand
alternatives: SELECT brand, (COUNT(*) - COUNT(category_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS missing_share FROM products GROUP BY brand
SELECT brand, SUM(CASE WHEN category_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS missing_share FROM products GROUP BY brand

other_way.sql: SELECT brand, (COUNT(*) - COUNT(category_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS missing_share FROM products GROUP BY brand
other_way.tradeoff: COUNT(*) minus COUNT(category_id) counts the missing values without a filter, but the FILTER says plainly what it counts.
